title: Evaluation of the parity output inputs
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number, let $G$ be either an AND or OR gate, and let $A$ assign a sign block to each index in $	ext{Fin}(r^0)$. Applying the gate dual to $G$ to the level-zero node values over the specified output input set equals the product of the signs in the block assigned by $A$ to the unique index in $	ext{Fin}(r^0)$.
